# wender-agent
Wender: the hard layer of Computer Use for AI agents (not a browser). Perceive any web page or desktop program as a deterministic JSON STATE, act by the most structured path, remember program maps and verified skills, learn from demonstrations. Pairs with vision-engine.
Start: AGENTS.md (ladder, layers, edit rules)
Tests: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .

- README.md
- docs/STATE.md
- hyperbooks/HB-WA-a0-arch/book.md
